content.title: FERC Approves NRG Energy Plan to Buy 12.9 GW of Gas-Fired Generation
content.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has signed off on NRG Energy’s plan to acquire nearly 13 GW of natural gas-fired power generation. The agency on November 13 said it supports Houston, Texas-based NRG’s $12-billion deal with New York-based LS Power for capacity in the PJM market territory.
